business_summary.text: SBI Cards and Payment Services Limited is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) registered with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). It is the second-largest credit card provider in the country, with a card base of 2.26 crore as on June 30, 2026.

operating_notes.text: New sourcing mix in FY26 stands at 54% from open market and 46% from banca channels.
Cards in force around 2.26 crore, up 7% YoY; market share 18.6% in cards and 19.5% in spends.
Sourcing mix: 47% Banca and 53% open market in Q1FY27.
Online spend contributed 63% of total retail spend; UPI on credit cards grew 13% QoQ.
Eternal SBI Card offers a 10% instant discount on Zomato, District and Bistro and on Blinkit electronics and beauty, capped at ₹2,000 a month across platforms.
The card offers 5% cashback up to ₹1,000 a month on Apollo 24/7, ixigo, Uber and Urban Company, and 1% base cashback up to ₹500 a month.
The card carries a ₹499 joining fee with a 6-month Zomato Gold membership, and an annual fee waiver at ₹2,00,000 of annual spends; it runs on Mastercard and RuPay.
Eternal SBI Card is a domestic cashback card launched with Eternal Ltd, disclosed under Regulation 30 and 51 of SEBI LODR.
Company holds an additional cumulative impairment provision of ₹100 crores over and above the approved ECL model.
New accounts crossed 1.1 million in Q2 FY27, up 18% YoY.
The company maintains sizeable liquidity backup in the form of sanctioned and unutilised bank lines of Rs. 14,600 crore as on June 30, 2026.
The company’s liquidity profile is characterised by positive cumulative mismatches in all buckets up to 1 year.
The company's borrowing profile leans towards bank borrowings (both bank lines and term loans), which accounted for the majority of the total borrowings (97.7%).

State Bank of India, as SBI Cards and Payment Services Limited promoter, confirms no encumbrance on equity shares during FY2025-26.
SBI Cards held its Q1FY27 earnings call on July 24, 2026, reporting PAT of ₹664 Cr (+20% YoY) and gross NPA of 2.04%.
On 15 October 2026, SBI Card and Eternal Limited (formerly Zomato) announced the launch and early access of the co-branded Eternal SBI Card, available from 22 October 2026.
On 15 October 2026, SBI Cards filed its exchange disclosure for the launch of the Eternal SBI Card, a domestic cashback card.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹5,140.53 Cr (+3.6% YoY), net profit ₹777.6 Cr (+74.8% YoY).
